rule: Excluded middle, proof by cases, composition with COMMISSION-TEACHING-INCLUSIVE-FROM-BOUNDS
meaning: Named governance coverage (narrow or teaching-inclusive criterion) without deciding whether teaching is governing: by the self-evident excluded middle, teaching is selected (then the teaching-inclusive criterion holds) or not (then, since every selected power is table-governing or teaching, the narrow criterion holds). Only the two OPEN bounding inclusions are needed.
